verdict.rationale: CPU+GPU offload is a fair axis for an LLM inference engine like vLLM, but nothing in the evidence pack documents offloading weights or layers to CPU memory to exceed VRAM. Quantization (vllm-docs-22) only shrinks the memory footprint. CPU support (vllm-docs-11) and multi-GPU parallelism (vllm-docs-13) are separate capabilities, not combined offload.
